dedupe_keys.name: pyspaceweather spaceweather python interface for ap kp and f10 7 indices

description: pyspaceweather, installed from PyPI as spaceweather, is a Python module that returns geomagnetic and solar activity indices as pandas tables. Stefan Bender maintains it as an open source project. It reads the CelesTrak space weather files, the GFZ Kp, ap and F10.7 files and OMNI data, giving 3-hourly Ap and Kp, daily sums and averages, observed and 1 AU adjusted F10.7 fluxes and 81-day running means, and ships packaged data files that can be refreshed with an update call. Coverage is global indices over the span of each source. Format and access: a pip package with documentation on Read the Docs. Licence: GPLv2 for the code, with the CelesTrak data included by permission; free. Caveats: the author marks it beta, and packaged data go stale unless updated. Thermospheric density and drag models used for satellite re-entry and conjunction work take these indices as inputs, so it serves hazard exposure studies of space assets. Related catalogue records are the GFZ Kp index and the SWVO data readers, a broader GFZ package.
